news.title: Thinkube 0.1, an alpha
news.body:
This is the first release of Thinkube. It is an alpha. Two hardware configurations have run it so far; yours may be the first of its kind.

An alpha means that things will break, and that there is no promised way to move a 0.1 cluster to a later release.

This page is how your cluster hears about fixes and news. Thinkube Control checks for them when it starts and every six hours. A fix is applied only when you click Apply.

To ask a question, use the Thinkube Zulip chat: https://thinkube.zulipchat.com/

To report a bug, open an issue at https://github.com/thinkube/thinkube/issues. Say what you ran, what you expected, and what happened, in the tool's own words.

fixes.title: Thinkube Control 0.1.4: venv templates
fixes.body:
Fixes:
- A venv created from a template gets the template's own installs as well as its packages.
- A built venv reaches the other GPU nodes; the copy no longer stops at a password prompt.
- A template that is no longer defined is removed from the list.

New: the fine-tuning-unsloth template.

Thinkube Control restarts during the update.

fixes.title: JupyterHub: the thinkube-unsloth notebooks
fixes.body:
Notebook servers get the notebooks of thinkube-unsloth in templates/unsloth/, and a copy in notebooks/unsloth/ the first time.

Notebook servers restart during the update.

fixes.title: Thinkube Control 0.1.3: Flare, and LLM engines declared by their components
fixes.body:
New: Flare, NVIDIA's inference server for Blackwell GPUs, as an optional component, with Qwen3.8 Flash Next for DGX Spark in the model catalog. It answers OpenAI and Anthropic requests through the LLM gateway.

Each inference engine now declares itself to the LLM gateway in its own thinkube.yaml, so a new engine is added as a template, with no change to Thinkube Control. After this update, the gateway offers an installed engine only once it declares itself: apply the Ollama 0.1.1 fix, and redeploy each installed vLLM, TensorRT-LLM and text-embeddings component. In Thinkube IDE, ask your agent: "redeploy the vllm component" (the redeploy_template tool).

Fixes:
- A model load stays within the namespace quota, and a pod that is refused or crashes fails the load with its reason.
- The model catalog is read again on demand, and each model can carry its own server arguments.
- Model mirrors download files over 50 GB through Xet.
- Model aliases, the agent mark and the agent default come from the model catalog. GET /v1/models describes each model for agent clients.

Flare locks memory. On a node installed before this release, containerd allows only 8 MiB of locked memory and Flare stops with ENOMEM. To allow it, write /etc/systemd/system/containerd.service.d/thinkube-limits.conf on the GPU node with the two lines [Service] and LimitMEMLOCK=infinity, then run sudo systemctl daemon-reload and sudo systemctl restart containerd. New installs have it.

Thinkube Control restarts during the update.

fixes.title: Ollama declares itself to the LLM gateway
fixes.body: Thinkube Control 0.1.3 reads the inference engines from their components. This fix writes Ollama's declaration into its service configuration, so the gateway offers Ollama again. The Ollama pod and its models are not changed.

fixes.title: Thinkube IDE: Pi uses the models the LLM gateway serves
fixes.body:
Pi reads its models from the LLM gateway when it starts: the models of the catalog marked agent that are loaded, and the agent default. A model loaded later appears in a new chat. In Tandem Chat, the model picker of the chat panel lists these models, and a picked model stays with its chat.

The opencode client is removed from the configuration; Tandem Chat is built on Pi.

Thinkube IDE restarts during the update. Save your work first.

fixes.title: Thinkube Control 0.1.2: LLM gateway, deploys, builds and training mode
fixes.body:
Fixes:
- The LLM gateway runs several one-model engines on a node, starts them one at a time, keeps load deadlines across restarts, and a Thinkube Control restart no longer restarts the models. Calibrated models are sized from their measured memory.
- spec.env values given at deploy reach the containers, and a redeploy keeps them.
- thinkube.yaml placeholders are resolved. App and Knative routes allow long requests (600 seconds, or the service's timeoutSeconds).
- A container may ask for more build memory with buildSize, and a test pod's memory with test.size.
- The LLM proxy answers 503, not 401, when a token cannot be checked. The CI/CD pages and API token checks no longer block other requests.

New: training mode reserves one node for a training; notebook jobs survive slow status calls and restarts; the Storage page shows the shared folders, their quotas and the disk under them.

Thinkube Control restarts during the update.

fixes.title: Knative services answer at their cluster address
fixes.body:
Every cluster address of a Knative service (http://<service>.<namespace>.svc.cluster.local) timed out, including the addresses that dependencies in thinkube.yaml give to an app. The local gateway listened on port 8081; it now listens on port 80.

Knative Serving also stays on the control plane, so training mode does not stop app revisions.

fixes.title: Builds keep running while a training reserves a node
fixes.body: Training mode stops every workload on the node it reserves. When the Argo Workflows controller, its server, Argo Events or the Gitea webhook ran on that node, a training stopped every build. They now stay on the control plane. The build pods themselves still run on both architectures.

fixes.title: ArgoCD keeps syncing while a training reserves a node
fixes.body: Training mode stops every workload on the node it reserves. When an ArgoCD component ran on that node, a training stopped every sync. ArgoCD now stays on the control plane.

fixes.title: JupyterHub: reserved memory, model cache and training jobs
fixes.body:
- A server that asks to reserve its memory gets all of it guaranteed.
- The MLflow volume caches a whole model on the node.
- A training's notebook job may run on the node training mode keeps free, and gets that node's training folder, kept across pods.

Notebook servers restart during the update.

fixes.title: Thinkube IDE: Claude Code 2.1.301 and the Tandem plugin
fixes.body:
Thinkube IDE gets Claude Code 2.1.301, the version the Tandem extension expects, and the Tandem plugin for Claude Code, which registers the Tandem tools. The Tandem tools are pre-approved. The agent instructions are updated.

Thinkube IDE restarts during the update. Save your work first.
